an10.1:1.2: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Park.
an10.1:1.3: Then the Venerable Ānanda approached the Blessed One, paid homage to him, sat down to one side, and said to him:
an10.1:2.1: (1) “Bhante, what is the purpose and benefit of wholesome virtuous behavior?”
an10.1:2.2: (2) “Ānanda, the purpose and benefit of wholesome virtuous behavior is non-regret.”
an10.1:3.1: (3) “And what, Bhante, is the purpose and benefit of non-regret?”
an10.1:3.2: “The purpose and benefit of non-regret is joy.”
an10.1:4.1: (4) “And what, Bhante, is the purpose and benefit of joy?”
an10.1:4.2: “The purpose and benefit of joy is rapture.”
an10.1:5.1: (5) “And what, Bhante, is the purpose and benefit of rapture?”
an10.1:5.2: “The purpose and benefit of rapture is tranquility.”
an10.1:6.1: (6) “And what, Bhante, is the purpose and benefit of tranquility?” “The purpose and benefit of tranquility is pleasure.”
an10.1:7.1: “And what, Bhante, is the purpose and benefit of pleasure?”
an10.1:7.2: “The purpose and benefit of pleasure is concentration.”
an10.1:8.1: (8) “And what, Bhante, is the purpose and benefit of concentration?”
an10.1:8.2: “The purpose and benefit of concentration is the knowledge and vision of things as they really are.”
an10.1:9.1: (9) “And what, Bhante, is the purpose and benefit of the knowledge and vision of things as they really are?”
an10.1:9.2: “The purpose and benefit of the knowledge and vision of things as they really are is disenchantment and dispassion.”
an10.1:10.1: (10) “And what, Bhante, is the purpose and benefit of disenchantment and dispassion?”
an10.1:10.2: “The purpose and benefit of disenchantment and dispassion is the knowledge and vision of liberation.
an10.1:11.1: “Thus, Ānanda, (1)–(2) the purpose and benefit of wholesome virtuous behavior is non-regret;
an10.1:11.2: (3) the purpose and benefit of non-regret is joy;
an10.1:11.3: (4) the purpose and benefit of joy is rapture;
an10.1:11.4: (5) the purpose and benefit of rapture is tranquility;
an10.1:11.5: (6) the purpose and benefit of tranquility is pleasure;
an10.1:11.6: (7) the purpose and benefit of pleasure is concentration;
an10.1:11.7: (8) the purpose and benefit of concentration is the knowledge and vision of things as they really are;
an10.1:11.9: (9) the purpose and benefit of the knowledge and vision of things as they really are is disenchantment and dispassion; and (10) the purpose and benefit of disenchantment and dispassion is the knowledge and vision of liberation.
an10.1:11.10: Thus, Ānanda, wholesome virtuous behavior progressively leads to the foremost.”
